description_en: Modifies the TLS security policy of a website forwarding rule
description_zh: 编辑网站业务转发规则的TLS安全策略
name: ModifyTlsConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.
The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The details of the TLS security policy, expressed as a JSON-formatted string with the following structure.
ssl_protocols: String type, required. The TLS version. Valid values:
    - tls1.0: TLS 1.0 and later are supported.
    - tls1.1: TLS 1.1 and later are supported.
    - tls1.2: TLS 1.2 and later are supported.
ssl_ciphers: String type, required. The cipher suite type. Valid values:
    - all: all cipher suites, including strong and weak cipher suites
    - improved: enhanced cipher suites
    - strong: strong cipher suites only
    - default: default cipher suites, which include only strong cipher suites
ssl_13_enabled: Boolean type, optional. Specifies whether to enable TLS 1.3. Valid values:
    - true: Enables TLS 1.3.
    - false: Disables TLS 1.3.
custom_ciphers: Array type, optional. The list of custom cipher suites for TLS versions earlier than 1.3.
tls_13_custom_ciphers: Array type, optional. The list of custom cipher suites for TLS 1.3. If TLS 1.3 is enabled, select at least one cipher suite for TLS versions earlier than 1.3
parameters.help_zh:
TLS安全策略的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表达，具体结构如下。
ssl_protocols：String类型，必选，TLS版本。取值：
    - tls1.0：支持TLS1.0及以上
    - tls1.1：支持TLS1.1及以上
    - tls1.2：支持TLS1.2及以上
ssl_ciphers：String类型，必选，加密套件类型。取值：
    - all：全部加密套件，包含强加密套件和弱加密套件
    - improved：增强加密套件
    - strong：强加密套件
    - default：默认，仅包含强加密套件
ssl_13_enabled：Boolean类型，可选，是否开启TLS1.3版本。取值：
    - true：开启TLS1.3版本
    - false：关闭TLS1.3版本
custom_ciphers：Array类型，可选，非1.3版本的自定义加密套件列表。
tls_13_custom_ciphers：Array类型，可选，1.3版本的自定义加密套件列表。若开启了 TLS1.3 开关，请至少选择一个非1.3版本的加密套件
parameters.name: config

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
